Date : 10-04-2024 This petition was called on for hearing today.

UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Heard learned counsel for the parties.
With the consent of the parties, the matter is referred to the Supreme Court Mediation Centre.
Accordingly, the parties are directed to appear before the Supreme Court Mediation Centre either personally or through the virtual mode on 23 rd April, 2024 at 2 p.m.

If the Mediator suggests that Aman Maheshwari vs The State Of Rajasthan on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165830147/
1 the presence of the parties is required, then a sum of Rs.25,000/- will be paid by the petitioner-husband to the respondent No.2-wife towards expenses for her physical appearance.
